segment.description: 'Upper Hills Creek' is TWRA's site label for the stocked upper reach of Hills Creek (GNIS 01287839) near Irving College, Warren County, in the Collins River subbasin (HUC 05130107) - not a separate GNIS-named stream and not any same-named Hills Creek in White/Van Buren/Haywood-NC/SC. Identity resolved from catalog hydroIdentity (GNIS 01287839, HUC 05130107) plus catalog notes ('TWRA spring-stocked Warren County creek') plus USGS station 03420260 (Warren Co. 177, HUC 05130107, 55.59 sq mi).
segment.boundaries: Catalog gives no reach limits beyond 'TWRA spring-stocked Warren County creek'. TWRA stocking sites S1 (35.5636,-85.6557) and S2 (35.5642,-85.6568), Irving College, spring program - the USGS temperature station 03420260 'HILLS CREEK NEAR IRVING COLLEGE, TN' (35.5684,-85.6803) sits on the same creek a short distance west of the sites.

coldSource.notes: Free-flowing tributary of the Dry Creek/Slaughter Cove Creek drainage, thence the Collins River (Caney Fork system above Center Hill Dam); no dam on the stocked reach. Catalog YAML carries no counties field (identity had to be resolved from hydroIdentity GNIS/HUC + notes + workbook county) - flagging as a catalog completeness item; USGS station county (177 Warren) confirms Warren.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found; TWRA's program here is seasonal spring put-and-take rainbow (2026 schedule: a single week, 3/22/2026, for 'Upper Hills Creek').

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found. The creek has no entry (special regulation or wild-trout listing) on TWRA's Tennessee Trout Regulations page as fetched 2026-09-18.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: The USGS grab record at Irving College includes a 28.0 C July reading (1980) and 22.0 C in September 1979 - classic warmwater summer peaks on a creek TWRA stocks only one spring week per year.
